earlier_scan.note: Glottolog refs for Jara (Chadic) are only wordlists/ethnography (Meek 1931, Jungraithmayr & Ibriszimow 1994); no grammar or phonology exists

sources.note: Record only: 46,000 (2000), Borno/Gombe LGAs, Chadic Biu-Mandara A.1 Tera group, 'displaced by Fulfulde and Hausa'. Nothing on phonology.

sources.citation: Gravina, Richard. 2014. The Phonology of Proto-Central Chadic: the reconstruction of the phonology and lexicon of Proto-Central Chadic, and the linguistic history of the Central Chadic languages. LOT Dissertation Series 375. Utrecht: LOT (PhD Leiden). https://www.lotpublications.nl/Documents/
sources.note: Nothing for Jara: Table 3 'Lexical data sources' (printed p.13, PDF p.41) reads 'Jara [jaf] Tera none' — Gravina had no data for Jara; sec. 3.3.4 (p.49) only places Jara in West Tera with Tera (after Newman 1977a); the reconstruction is stated to exclude 'tone or stress' (p.3). No Jara phonology, no stress statement.

sources.citation: Blench, Roger. 2012. An Atlas of Nigerian Languages, 3rd ed., entry 212 'Jara'; Blench, Roger. 2020. An Atlas of Nigerian Languages (2020 draft ed.), entry 215 'Jara'. Wayback copies of rogerblench.info PDFs.
sources.note: Entry gives only: '1.A Jera / 3. Borno State, Biu LGA; Bauchi State, Ako LGA / 4. 4,000 (SIL) / 5. Chadic: Biu-Mandara sub-branch A: Tera group'. No Source(s)/Refs line at all — Blench lists no linguistic source for Jara. Nothing on phonology or stress.

sources.note: Jara is not among Kraft's 67 languages; no Jara data.
